name: Weasel, cats & otter
description: Small native carnivores - the Patagonian weasel huron (Lyncodon patagonicus), Geoffroy's cat (Leopardus geoffroyi), the pampas cat pajeros (Leopardus pajeros) and the southern river otter huillin (Lontra provocax). Functional group pooling 4 source nodes (4 native, 0 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); all are small predator-scavengers of rodents, hare and rabbit - the otter appears in the source web chiefly as condor carrion.
